shock_band: Euclidean distance to domain-clipped exact front; dense polyline approximation; combined is mask union
shock_band_rmse: sqrt(mean((prediction-reference)^2)) on masked existing Cartesian grid nodes; not relative L2
shock_band_missing: empty band -> NaN RMSE and zero point count; independent of shock detection
location: closest downward midpoint crossing on exact local unit normal; absolute offset
aggregation: each time separately; arc-length weighting across both fronts
detection: detected arc weight / total exact interior arc weight; no distance-accuracy cutoff
prediction: bilinear interpolation of existing evaluation grid; no model re-query
missing: location statistics conditional on detected samples; missing values remain NaN
width: 10-90% normal distance, nearest bracketing threshold crossings around selected midpoint; invalid remains NaN
width_resolution: underresolved if width < minimum_width_cells * max(hx,hy); diagnostic heuristic
width_valid_rate: valid-width arc weight / total exact interior arc weight
interpolation_limit: dense interpolation does not improve underlying grid resolution
